summary.intent: Deploy v0.25.0 to staging after merging a release PR, then investigate and fix staging issues found during smoke testing (slow IPNS publishes, broken token refresh), and resolve a cascade of release-please configuration problems that blocked automated release PR creation.
summary.outcome: Deployed v0.25.1 to staging (manually tagged), fixed IPNS publish latency by making DHT propagation fire-and-forget, consolidated the web app from 3 HTTP client paths to 1 by removing the duplicate orval react-query generation, and unblocked release-please after diagnosing that manually creating the v0.25.1 tag left PR #306 with the `autorelease: pending` label and that old single-package PRs had unparseable titles under the new monorepo config.

repo: deploy-staging.yml triggers only on `v*-staging*` tags — release tags do not auto-deploy to staging; the 'Tag Staging Release' manual workflow must be run explicitly
CipherBox API is intentionally zero-knowledge: it never handles plaintext or performs encryption, so it has no workspace package dependencies (@cipherbox/core, @cipherbox/crypto)

The web app had two separate orval codegen pipelines: packages/api-client (axios, for SDK/desktop consumers) and apps/web/src/api/ (react-query fetch, for web only) — almost all web code used raw functions not hooks, making the second pipeline redundant

release-please tracks untagged release PRs via the `autorelease: pending` label, not PR title — manually creating a git tag without going through release-please leaves the label uncleared and causes all future runs to abort
release-please v4 scans ALL merged PRs regardless of bootstrap-sha; bootstrap-sha only affects commit scanning, so old PRs with unparseable titles block indefinitely
packages/crypto/package.json was incorrectly listed in release-please extra-files, causing version bumps on every release even when crypto source was unchanged

code.finding: DHT delegated routing publish was awaited, causing 10-30s latency. DB record is saved before the await and resolveRecord() always prefers DB cache, so the await was unnecessary — changed to fire-and-forget with trailing .catch() for error logging

Raw fetch mutator for orval-generated react-query hooks had zero 401 handling — token refresh only existed on the axios client used during login/vault init, causing unrecoverable 401s after 15-minute access token expiry. File deleted as part of consolidation.

Added refreshAccessToken callback with shared-promise deduplication, withCredentials for HTTP-only cookie support, and 401 response interceptor with retry — this is now the single auth HTTP layer for the entire web app

Custom pull-request-title-pattern 'chore: release' without ${component} caused component to be undefined when release-please tried to match merged PRs to packages. Removing the custom pattern resolved it, but only after also relabeling PR #306 from autorelease:pending to autorelease:tagged

Download-with-progress path used raw fetch with manual auth headers, bypassing the 401 interceptor. Replaced with axios onDownloadProgress which works correctly for blob responses, eliminating the duplicate client path

CI verify-generated-client step was diffing all of packages/api-client/ — would incorrectly fail on edits to instance.ts, tests, or package.json. Fixed to only diff the generated paths: openapi.json, src/generated/, src/models/

workflow: chore commits do not trigger release-please version bumps — use fix(ci) when a CI fix should create a patch release, chore(ci) when it should not

Manually creating git tags for a release (to unblock staging) requires also manually relabeling the release PR from autorelease:pending to autorelease:tagged, otherwise release-please permanently blocks on it

When switching a repo from single-package to monorepo release-please config, all historical release PRs become unparseable under the new title pattern — renaming them via GitHub API is not sufficient since matching is label-based

friction: release-please was blocked for an extended period across 6+ PRs and 10+ workflow runs: bootstrap-sha didn't help, deleting the release branch didn't help, renaming 58+ old PR titles didn't help — the actual cause (autorelease:pending label on PR #306 from manually tagging v0.25.1) was not discovered until late
Grafana Cloud provisioning failed transiently due to free-tier instance hibernation, causing a false alarm during the Tag Staging Release workflow

The Dockerfile for apps/api had a stale COPY for packages/crypto that the API doesn't actually depend on, which only surfaced as a build failure after the expanded package list was introduced in a new release
Two separate orval codegen pipelines existed for years with only 1 of 8000+ generated react-query hooks actually being used
open_items: React Query cache is not cleared on logout or token refresh failure — noted as a pre-existing gap, deferred as follow-up work
packages/crypto removal from release-please extra-files (fix being prepared at end of transcript) not yet merged
Tag Staging Release workflow still needs to be run with the final release version (v0.25.2) once all PRs are merged and release-please creates the release
IPNS batch delete performance (the original trigger for the debug session) needs verification on staging after the fire-and-forget fix ships
Token refresh fix (PR #309) needs E2E verification on staging with a long-running session to confirm 401 recovery works end-to-end
